instructions_to_main_agent: Always render the system in explicit DEMO MODE with prominent badges ('DEMO MODE: Simulated Platform & Hypothetical Calculations').
Implement 3 clear route modes or toggles: Public Marketing Website, User Dashboard, and Super Admin Panel.

Marketing page must include: Hero ('One Platform. Complete Financial Account Management.'), key benefits grid, 8 demo investment/participation plans with dynamic profit calculator, 5 trading asset categories with risk warnings, 5-level referral team diagram, 4 luxury reward milestone cards, interactive FAQ, and footer.

User Dashboard must include: Sidebar nav (mobile responsive sheet/drawer), balance stat cards, interactive Recharts earnings chart, deposit screen with simulated USDT/BTC QR code + copy address + file upload, withdrawal flow, referral team network tree, and notifications modal with clickable action links.

Super Admin Dashboard must include: Dense data tables with bulk action checkboxes (approve/reject deposits, user status changes), CMS content editor for plans/notices, platform setting toggles, and detailed log records.
ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, tables, dropdowns, modals) MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='plan-calculator-input').
Never rely on pure transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays; use dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070A12]/80) to preserve text readability.
